name: After Closing
source:
A character-driven visual novel mixing shop gameplay, workplace friendships, and romance. Get through your shifts, spend time with the people around you, and decide how close you want to get. A conversation might lead to flirting, a friendship, or something you’ll wish you could take back.

Between checkout duties and time off, you’ll get to know Hikari, Camille, and Amara. Find your favorite, explore different choices, and discover what happens when work relationships become personal.

[Edited from [url=https://despeon.itch.io/after-closing]itch.io[/url]]
